title: Recovery doctor console
description: Objective: implement project health, doctor checks, reconciliation inventory, backup/RPO, and exact recovery command surfaces. Deliverable: recovery/doctor modules. NOT in scope: optimistic auto-repair or browser-executed disaster restore. Hard dependencies: Generated control-room client and Crash reconciliation services. Owned paths: apps/control-room/src/recovery/** and apps/control-room/src/doctor/**. Verification: pnpm --filter @moe/control-room test.
definitionOfDone: HEALTHY, DEGRADED, and UNKNOWN_TRUTH are distinct and every check exposes stable ID/evidence/affected records.
Only daemon-supplied recovery commands are actionable; uncertainty disables mutation.
Backup cursor/RPO and orphan inventory limitations are explicit.
taskRails: The standalone control room displays daemon truth and nextAllowedCommands; it never derives authority, readiness, or evidence strength.
Every fact is text/icon/color encoded, keyboard accessible, provenance-drillable, and honest under degraded data.
IDE adapters remain thin optional launch/discover/embed shells with no product logic. Keep modules below 400 lines; explicit owned paths only.
